papers.title_en: Disentangling Robustness and Sycophancy in Multilingual LLMs
papers.authors: Rhitabrat Pokharel, Ameeta Agrawal
papers.evidence: 直接分析并测量多语言大模型的谄媚行为
papers.tldr: 多语言大模型认同用户的错误前提，既可能源于迎合，也可能只是缺乏该语言下的知识，现有评估往往混淆二者。论文提出SC矩阵，将无压力时能否正确作答与受压后能否保持正确答案交叉分析。结果显示，相同总体迎合率可掩盖不同失败构成，较高语言能力也不必然抵御迎合，推理导向干预优于指令式策略。这一框架将多语言迎合拆解为不同失败模式，为区分能力不足与抗压失效、选择针对性干预提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: When a multilingual LLM agrees with a user's false premise, is it being sycophantic, or does it simply not know better in that language? Current research does not distinguish these cases: they record only whether the model agreed, not why. We introduce the SC-matrix, that crosses a model's competence (whether it answers correctly under no pressure) with its sycophancy (whether it maintains that answer under pressure). Our results show that (1) identical aggregate sycophancy rates can mask different failure compositions, (2) high competence in a language does not always protect against sycophancy, and (3) reasoning-oriented mitigations outperform directive-based strategies. We find that multilingual sycophancy is not a single phenomenon but a composite of different failures that require distinct diagnosis.

papers.title_en: Cross-User Adaptation for sEMG Gesture Recognition via Continual Learning
papers.authors: Aran Ramakrishnan, Shubhi Mishra, Tyler Ham, Assel Kembay, Jason Eshraghian
papers.evidence: 研究辅助交互界面中的肌电手势识别持续适应
papers.tldr: 表面肌电手势识别受个体差异影响，部署后适应新用户和新手势容易遗忘旧知识。论文在NinaPro DB1上比较经验回放、弹性权重巩固与直接微调，覆盖域增量和类别增量场景。经验回放的类别增量最终准确率达83.3%，遗忘降幅仅1.8%—5.8%，优于另两种策略。实验还发现，按时间顺序训练会导致单类预测坍塌，打乱独立窗口并采用无状态训练可保持稳定，为持续个性化适配提供实践依据。
papers.abstract_en: Prosthetic and assistive interfaces increasingly depend on decoding hand gestures from surface electromyography (sEMG). Because the signal is shaped by person-specific factors, the recurrent neural networks (RNNs) commonly used to model these temporal streams must adapt to new wearers and new gesture classes after deployment. Continual learning (CL) enables this adaptation without retraining from scratch, yet applying it to recurrent sEMG models is not straightforward. Standard recurrent training practices can destabilize learning, and which CL strategy holds up under realistic cross-user drift is unestablished. We evaluate three representative CL strategies under domain- and class-incremental drift on NinaPro DB1, and find experience replay to outperform elastic weight consolidation (EWC) and naive fine-tuning. It reaches 83.3% final accuracy for class-incremental drift while limiting forgetting to 1.8-5.8% accuracy drop, as against 16.2-28.5% for EWC and naive training. We further show these models must be trained on shuffled, independently-windowed segments. Streaming windows in temporal order collapses the network into predicting a single dominant gesture, while a shuffled, stateless regime trains stably. Finally, hand-crafted time-domain features raise per-task accuracy by up to about 40% over raw signals, but only replay preserves that gain under class-incremental drift.

papers.title_en: BE-CTDE: Blockchain-Enabled Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Anomaly Detection and Token Economics
papers.authors: Chih-Wei Huang, Hsin-Chieh Lee, Yun-Chen Yu, Ibrahim Althamary, Rongxing Lu, Phone Lin
papers.evidence: 以激励机制维护多智能体强化学习中的合作行为
papers.tldr: 多智能体强化学习中的策略性偏离会破坏协作，并削弱训练可信度。BE-CTDE将区块链作为训练管理层，通过轨迹核验触发代币罚没、销毁、奖励与补偿，再以保留余额决定各智能体对全局策略更新的贡献权重。路径规划实验中，即使攻击者占多数，该方法仍保持更高成功率，碰撞率较两类部分防御基线最多降低35%和43%。论文还给出单轮激励条件、有限期望排除时间及检测容量边界，刻画行为核验与经济反馈的作用条件。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning supports cooperative decision-making in Internet of Things systems, but strategic deviations can disrupt coordination and undermine confidence in the training process. This paper proposes Blockchain-Enabled Centralized Training and Decentralized Execution (BE-CTDE), which uses blockchain as an active training-management layer. A behavioral verifier compares executed trajectories with shared-policy recommendations; its flags drive a token mechanism combining slashing, burning, rewards, and compensation. Retained balances determine each agent's contribution to the global policy update, connecting auditable behavior to learning influence. We derive a one-round incentive condition that accounts for action-dependent compensation and the payoff from deviation, and a finite expected exclusion-time bound under explicit conditional detection and accounting assumptions, showing perfect detection is unnecessary. An exact finite-population capacity bound characterizes the limits of the population-relative detector. In multi-agent path finding experiments, BE-CTDE outperforms a state-of-the-art learning-based path planner with substantially higher success rates under attack, even when adversaries form the majority. It also outperforms partially defended baselines in all configurations, with collision rates up to 35% lower than under detection without economic consequences and up to 43% lower than under conventional stake slashing. Together, these results characterize how behavioral verification and token feedback can support accountable cooperative learning.

papers.title_en: Centralized Critics for N-Agent Ad Hoc Teamwork
papers.authors: Andrew McAlinden, Caroline Wang, Steven Shi, Arrasy Rahman, Elad Liebman, Peter Stone
papers.evidence: 研究多智能体强化学习团队协作中的集中式评论器
papers.tldr: 多智能体即席协作中，受控智能体需与未知且动态变化的队友配合，但集中式评价器应使用哪些训练信息尚不明确。论文比较仅使用受控智能体观测与动作历史、以及额外纳入非受控队友历史的两类优势估计器。理论证明两者均无偏，并刻画联合历史估计严格降低方差的条件；实验中，联合历史评价器表现持平或更优，改善样本效率与最终回报。这为训练时利用队友历史、执行时保持信息受限提供了理论依据与实践建议。
papers.abstract_en: Centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) has become the dominant paradigm in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), motivating extensive study of what privileged information should be made available to the critic during training. While prior work has examined the role of global state in fully cooperative settings, the design of centralized critics for N-agent ad hoc teamwork - in which dynamically varying set of learning agents must coordinate with an arbitrary set of uncontrolled teammates drawn from an unknown distribution - remains poorly understood. We study this question by comparing two natural classes of advantage estimators: controlled history estimators, which condition only on the observation and action histories of the learner's own agents, and joint history estimators, which additionally condition on the histories of the uncontrolled teammates. We prove that both estimators are unbiased and characterize the conditions under which the joint history estimate attains strictly lower variance than its controlled counterpart. Empirically, joint history critics match or outperform controlled history critics across a range of NAHT tasks, yielding improved sample efficiency and final returns. Together, these results provide both a theoretical justification and an empirical recommendation for incorporating uncontrolled agent histories into centralized critics for N-agent ad hoc teamwork.

papers.title_en: Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor Critic for Decentralized LLM Collaboration
papers.authors: Tianle Chen, Shuo Liu, Christopher Amato
papers.evidence: 以多智能体强化学习提升去中心化语言模型协作
papers.tldr: 去中心化大模型协作中，智能体独立执行、通信有限，却需共同完成任务；预设工作流也限制了协作效率与扩展性。论文提出信念条件化多智能体演员—评论家方法BCMAAC，维护对上下文信息的信念，并将其用于辅助训练。在Minecraft游戏、网页搜索和工具使用任务中，该方法相比朴素演员—评论家基线提升了任务表现与协作行为，多轮且上下文丰富时优势更明显。结果表明，信念建模有助于改善有限通信下的大模型协作。
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has explored optimizing LLM collaboration through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), but many approaches still rely on predefined workflows, limiting efficiency and scalability. Decentralized LLM collaboration is challenging because agents execute independently with limited communication, share a joint objective, and must infer useful information from communication traces. In this paper, we propose BCMAAC, a Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor-Critic method that maintains beliefs over contextual information and uses them to facilitate training. Experiments on Minecraft game-playing, web searching and tool-using tasks show that BCMAAC improves task performance and collaborative behavior compared to naive actor-critic baselines. The improvements are particularly pronounced in multi-turn tasks with richer contextual information, where belief modeling provides a clear advantage.

papers.title_en: Visible Reasoning: User-Facing Decision Transparency for Generative AI Systems
papers.authors: Sanjay Krishna Anbalagan, Xinrui Nie, Anughna Kommalapati, Vijay Kumar Kanamarlapudi, Sreekanth Radhakrishnan, Xiaodan Zhao, Umesh Mohan
papers.evidence: 面向用户展示决策理由与依据，提升生成式人工智能的透明度。
papers.tldr: 生成式人工智能融合多源信息，用户难以判断结论依据及出错原因。论文提出过滤决策日志，不暴露原始思维链，而是展示简洁决策理由、按影响排序的工具证据及来源相关性。方法从运行轨迹重建溯源树，以四类语义和结构信号自适应加权排序。在职业、投资和旅行三类任务中，50名参与者的评估显示92%认为排序证据有助于理解和信任建议；工具移除实验进一步支持排序反映决策依赖，为用户接受、纠正或重新运行系统提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Across multiple waves of computing, public trust in new technology has followed the emergence of governance mechanisms that made dominant risks legible and manageable. Generative AI shifts this pattern: these systems synthesize across heterogeneous sources, and users increasingly experience them as reasoning systems. The central question changes from "did it perform correctly?" to "can we trust how it arrived at its conclusion?"   This paper introduces Filtered Decision Logs (FDLs), a user-facing transparency mechanism that makes decision formation visible without exposing raw chain-of-thought. FDLs pair each response with (i) a concise decision rationale, (ii) influence-ordered supporting data points derived from tool outputs, and (iii) relevance indicators showing which sources most shaped the conclusion. To operationalize evidence selection, we propose a trace-based method that reconstructs observability telemetry into a provenance tree and ranks evidence using four deterministic semantic and structural signals - Final Answer Similarity, Average Relevancy, Persistence, and Structural Proximity - combined via adaptive weighted scoring. We demonstrate FDLs across three domains: career advising (5 tools), investment analysis (4 tools), and travel planning (4 tools). In a formative evaluation with 50 participants (25 students, 25 working professionals in AI development), 92% rated the influence-ranked evidence as helpful for understanding and trusting the system's recommendation. Counterfactual tool-removal experiments confirm that removing the top-ranked source changes the answer more than removing a low-ranked source, validating that the ranking tracks decision dependence. We conclude that evidence-ranked transparency helps users identify misleading signals and missing context, enabling more confident acceptance, correction, or re-run of system decisions.

papers.title_en: The Agent in the Middle: How AI-Mediated Access Reshapes Web Vulnerability Exploitation
papers.authors: Ruozhao Yang, Jiongchi Yu, Ming Hu, Xiaofei Xie
papers.evidence: 研究用户委托网页任务给智能体后的安全风险
papers.tldr: 当用户通过AI智能体直接调用网站后端时，既有漏洞是否仍可利用，取决于哪些因素？研究构建覆盖12类Web应用、44个漏洞的VELA基准，对比三款商业智能体与多种接口配置。参考配置下91%的漏洞仍可利用，智能体完成了直接调用接口可实现的全部攻击；接口配置使漏洞保留率在39%至95%间变化，智能体间差异至多4.5个百分点。结果表明，安全边界主要取决于接口设计，但收紧接口也可能损害正常功能。
papers.abstract_en: Web services increasingly expose backend interfaces that let users delegate tasks to AI agents, which invoke service operations directly without navigating websites. This shift changes how existing Web vulnerabilities can be exploited. We investigate these changes through VELA, an executable benchmark covering 44 vulnerabilities across twelve Web application families. The benchmark preserves vulnerable backends and derives agent-facing interfaces from legitimate workflows. We evaluate three commercial agents across multiple interface configurations, using controlled comparisons to separate interface effects from agent behavior and independent oracles to verify attack outcomes. Our results show that the agent realizes every attack that direct interface invocation realizes in the reference configuration, so exploitability is set mainly by the interface: 91% of vulnerabilities remain exploitable under the reference design. Interface restrictions prevent some attacks by removing required operations or limiting input control, while retention remains high across vulnerability classes. No case-level loss in the reference configuration is attributed to agent refusal or input normalization, and in one case the agent completed an attack by supplying calls the attacker omitted. Across the tested configurations, interface design affects exploitability more than agent choice, moving retention from 39% to 95% against at most 4.5 points across agents, but some restrictive interfaces also limit legitimate workflows. Our study provides a systematic empirical account of how agent-mediated access reshapes existing Web vulnerabilities, grounding future Web architecture design in measured security outcomes and trade-offs between reducing attack exposure and preserving legitimate functionality in agent-facing services.

papers.title_en: Preference-Guided Cooperation in Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Qiyue Xia, J. Michael Herrmann
papers.evidence: 直接研究多智能体强化学习中的合作与协调
papers.tldr: 多目标多智能体强化学习既要协调智能体，又要权衡冲突目标，将两者分开处理会带来高昂复杂度。论文提出MIRL，通过逐目标反事实信用分配衡量各智能体对团队目标的贡献，并利用元梯度学习个体目标偏好，使个体优先级服务于系统整体优化。多目标多粒子环境实验表明，静态与动态变体均改善了相对基线的帕累托前沿质量，其中动态变体表现最强。其核心贡献是将多目标结构从额外优化负担转化为引导协作的信息。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning (MOMARL) addresses agent coordination and objective trade-offs simultaneously while optimising overall system performance. Existing work tends to treat multi-agent cooperation and multi-objective optimisation as largely independent components of a learning problem, which amounts to an exorbitant complexity except in trivial cases. We study here whether the structure provided by multiple objectives can itself be exploited to facilitate cooperation, rather than being treated as an additional optimisation challenge. We formulate MOMARL at both the team and individual levels and introduce objective-wise counterfactual credit assignment to evaluate each agent's contribution across the team objectives. We propose Meta-Gradient Informed Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MIRL), with static (MIRL-S) and dynamic (MIRL-D) variants. By incorporating meta-gradient information, MIRL enables agents to learn how to prioritise objectives individually while collectively optimising the system-level objective, allowing the multi-objective structure to directly guide cooperation. Experiments on a multi-objective multiple particle environment show that our methods improve Pareto-front quality over baselines, with the dynamic variant achieving the strongest performance.

papers.title_en: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading
papers.authors: Giorgos Iacovides, Oliver Hannibal, Wuyang Zhou, Danilo Mandic
papers.evidence: 将金融大语言模型用于算法交易中的情绪分析
papers.tldr: 现有金融情感分析通常孤立解读新闻，缺乏公司背景，且预测依据难以核查。FinLLM-KG在推理时引入源自SEC 10-K年报、具有时间依据的金融知识图谱，以公司简介或相关事实三元组补充上下文，无需更新模型权重。模拟交易显示，该框架相较最先进基线持续改善投资组合表现，但摘要未披露具体增幅。通过将情感分数归因到新闻句子与检索事实，框架兼顾背景感知与证据可检查性，支持金融决策中的人工复核。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to predicting the sentiment of each article in isolation and operate as black boxes, which limits contextual understanding and hinders deployment in high-stakes financial decision-making. To this end, we introduce FinLLM-KG, a model-agnostic framework that combines causal LLMs with a financial knowledge graph, in order to inject temporally grounded, company-level knowledge from SEC 10-K filings at inference time, without updating model weights. Within FinLLM-KG, context is supplied either as a natural-language company profile or as a small set of relevance-ranked factual triples. This enables sentiment predictions to account for broader firm-level information rather than the article alone, at almost zero computational cost and for any causal LLM. In addition, attributing each article-level sentiment score to individual sentences and to the retrieved knowledge-graph facts makes the evidence behind the prediction inspectable, thereby enhancing explainability and supporting human-in-the-loop review. Simulations demonstrate that FinLLM-KG consistently improves portfolio performance over the state-of-the-art baseline.

papers.title_en: Normative Deviation Modeling for EEG-based Depression Detection
papers.authors: Wan Jiang, Jingqi Cheng, Hui Zhang, Xu Zhao, Xiaojing Chen, Shengeng Tang, Jingjing Wu, Richang Hong
papers.evidence: 利用脑电健康常模偏离进行抑郁症检测
papers.tldr: 脑电抑郁症检测易受个体差异和采集条件影响，跨数据源泛化仍具挑战。本文仅用健康对照训练结构与分布参考模型，将相对健康模式的偏离分别以标量分数或逐维残差融入深度脑电表征，并借助目标源健康对照校准预测分数，无需更新模型。两个公开数据集上的受试者独立同源及双向跨源实验支持该策略的有效性，但摘要未报告具体数值。其贡献在于为抑郁症检测提供健康常模偏离引导的建模路径。
papers.abstract_en: Web-enabled digital health services are expanding access to physiological monitoring and mental health screening. However, electroencephalography (EEG)-based major depressive disorder (MDD) detection remains challenging across heterogeneous data sources, where individual variability and acquisition differences may affect disease-related representations. In this work, we investigate the use of healthy normative references for EEG-based MDD detection. Specifically, structural and distributional reference models are independently trained using healthy control (HC) recordings to characterize departures from healthy EEG patterns. We develop two diagnostic approaches that incorporate normative deviations at different representation levels. Scalar-level Normative Deviation-guided Diagnosis (S-NDD) summarizes structural and distributional deviations into scalar scores and integrates them with deep EEG representations. Feature-level Normative Deviation-guided Diagnosis (F-NDD) retains dimension-wise residuals and combines them with deep EEG representations through attention-based aggregation and auxiliary supervision. We also employ target HC-assisted score calibration for cross-source evaluation without updating the trained models. Experiments on two public EEG datasets examine both approaches under subject-independent within-source and bidirectional cross-source settings. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of normative deviation-guided diagnosis across different evaluation settings.

papers.title_en: Comparing Temporal Deep Learning Architectures for Discrete Cross-User Myoelectric Control
papers.authors: Ethan Eddy, Evan Campbell, Scott Bateman, Erik Scheme
papers.evidence: 基准比较肌电控制中的动态手势识别方法
papers.tldr: 离散肌电控制可将动态手势映射为交互指令，但免校准跨用户模型的优化方法与真实场景泛化能力仍待验证。研究基于612名用户的肌电数据，比较五种时序深度学习架构、模型复杂度及人工与学习式特征。CNN-GRU在184名未见用户上达到93%准确率，模型在跨五年、跨国家采集的随机提示连续数据上达到96%。结果支持零样本跨用户离散肌电控制的可行性，为免个性化校准的人机交互提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: The recognition of dynamic gestures via discrete myoelectric control is becoming an attractive input modality for event-based human-machine interaction. While recent work suggests that discrete cross-user models are possible (i.e., no calibration data is required from the end user), few have evaluated techniques to optimize these systems and their generalizability to new randomly prompted data simulating real-world discrete control is relatively unknown. Using the 612-user EMG-EPN dataset, this work benchmarks five temporal deep-learning approaches, evaluates the tradeoff between performance and model complexity, and compares hand-crafted and machine-learned feature extraction techniques. The CNN-GRU achieved the best accuracy of 93% when tested on 184 previously unseen users. These models were then evaluated on a different, more realistic, unsegmented dataset, wherein users were randomly prompted to elicit discrete gestures during a continuous data collection. This dataset was recorded five years apart and in a separate country from the data used to train the original model. Results show that the cross-user results scale to this new dataset (accuracies of 96%) even though no feedback was given to users during the elicitation of gestures. These findings highlight the exciting potential of discrete zero-shot cross-user myoelectric control and offer valuable insights for the continued advancement of this promising technology.

papers.title_en: PolyGandr: Steering Generative Models via Spatial Navigation through Latent Space
papers.authors: Mingwei S. G. Li, Susie S. Y. Li, Isabel Moreira de Oliveira, Ryan P. Adams, Remco Chang
papers.evidence: 通过可视化界面实现对生成模型的直接交互控制
papers.tldr: 自然语言适合表达生成意图，却难以高效支持细粒度控制、反复修改与开放探索。PolyGandr将生成控制转化为高维潜在空间导航，通过地图与混合调色板统一设置起点、方向和步长，结合全局探索与局部细化。研究覆盖人脸生成、椅子设计和旋转剪纸工程，形成性研究表明其可支持实时编辑并提供设计空间概览。该系统为提示词工作流补充了空间化交互方式，减少将视觉意图反复转写为语言的需要。
papers.abstract_en: Generative models support content creation across text, images, videos, and design disciplines, yet their interfaces rely primarily on natural language. While effective for specifying high-level intent, language can be inefficient and imprecise for fine-grained control, iterative refinement, and open-ended exploration. We present PolyGandr, a visual interface for exploring relationships between latent representations and generated outputs, complementing natural-language model steering. PolyGandr formulates generative control as high-dimensional navigation, enabling users to define starting points, steering directions, and step sizes through a unified map-and-mixing-palette interface. Combining global exploration with local refinement supports both broad design-space navigation and fine-grained output manipulation without repeatedly translating visual intent into prompts. We evaluate PolyGandr across three use cases: StyleGAN2 face generation, Stable Diffusion chair design, and rotational kirigami engineering. A formative study indicates that PolyGandr complements existing workflows by supporting real-time editing while simultaneously providing an overview and means to explore the broader design space.

papers.title_en: Co^2Gen: Collaboratively Generating Task Plans for Decentralized Multi-Robot and Human Collaboration
papers.authors: Yi Loo, Siddhant Shrivastava, Minh Long Pham, Malika Meghjani
papers.evidence: 利用协作生成的任务计划与示范训练分布式人机协作模型
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作模型虽面向通用机器人任务，但与其他机器人及人类协作的能力仍缺乏研究，协作示范数据的采集也依赖人工遥操作。本文提出Co^2Gen，通过去中心化协同规划生成可执行函数形式的多机器人任务计划，再据此自动生成协作示范数据，用于去中心化微调模型。实验表明，使用这些自动生成数据微调的模型，在去中心化协作任务上的表现可匹敌使用人工遥操作协作数据微调的模型，为减少协作训练的数据采集成本提供了路径。
papers.abstract_en: Visual Language Action (VLA) models are designed to be generalist robot models that can be implemented across embodiments, tasks and environments. However, their ability to collaborate with other robots and humans remains underexplored. In this work, we propose a framework to automate the generation of multi-robot collaborative data for decentralized VLA training without requiring human teleoperation. Our framework first utilizes a decentralized collaborative planning approach to generate multi-robot collaborative robot plans in the form of an executable function. We then utilize the collaborative plan to produce collaborative demonstration data to finetune VLA models in a decentralized manner. We show that our approach produces demonstration data that when used to finetune VLA models on decentralized collaboration tasks matches the task performance of VLA models finetuned on human-teleoperated collaborative data.

papers.title_en: Context-Aware Generation and Modulation of Expressive Motion Behavior using Multimodal Foundation Models
papers.authors: Till Hielscher, Fabio Scaparro, Kai O. Arras
papers.evidence: 根据文本、音频和视频生成情境化表达动作
papers.tldr: 机器人动作的表达性有助于人机互动，但如何随多模态情境自动生成并调整全身手势仍具挑战。本文以动态运动基元统一实现动画原则，利用多模态基础模型组合手势序列并调节动作参数，再通过知识蒸馏降低连续控制的开销。用户研究显示，相比未调制和接口级条件，该系统的动作被认为更贴合互动情境。研究还展示了不同运动学结构机器人的动作生成，为可解释、可组合的跨形态表达性运动提供了方案。
papers.abstract_en: Expressive robot motion positively impacts human-robot interaction by improving user engagement, likability, or task performance. We present a novel approach to automatically generate and modulate complex, expressive full-body gesture sequences from a multimodal (text, audio, video) context description. Based on a unified mathematical implementation of the Principles of Animation using Dynamic Movement Primitives, we use multimodal foundation models to generate such sequences along with parametric motion variations that are highly context-aware. This method extends the state of the art in terms of flexibility and generality by being interpretable, composable, and working across different robot morphologies. Moreover, we integrate the system into a continuous control framework and leverage knowledge distillation to learn a much smaller model, significantly improving token efficiency and system latency. Results from a user study with a human-like platform indicate that participants judged our system's motions to be better aligned with the interaction context than motions produced under a non-modulated or API-level condition. We also demonstrate how the system generates expressive motion for robots with different kinematics, showcasing its versatility. Paper webpage: https://gen-mod-expressive-motion-behavior.github.io/.

papers.title_en: EREBOTS 4.0: A framework for conversational assistants with A2A agents and MCP tools
papers.authors: Elia Pacioni, Davide Calvaresi, Andrei C. Coman, Ismael Jaggi, Valerio Crocetti, Gaetano Manzo, Michael Ignaz Schumacher
papers.evidence: 面向对话助手构建可组合的智能体与工具协作框架。
papers.tldr: 语言模型多智能体系统缺少统一的组合框架，导致基础设施重复开发、研究结果难以复现。EREBOTS 4.0以语言模型规划和路由请求，经A2A协议调用专家智能体，并通过MCP接入确定性工具。框架支持配置网址接入本地或远程智能体，并管理身份、带同意标记的用户上下文及任务状态与追踪。其A2A服务器通过官方兼容性测试中97项已跟踪要求且无失败，为可互操作的混合AI对话助手提供开源基础设施。
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, multi-agent systems have shifted from rule-based, symbolic agents to sub-symbolic agents built on language models. However, several limitations remain unresolved. The new frontier is neuro-symbolic agents, which pair language models with deterministic tools and explicit protocols. Without a common framework to standardize and compose them, each study rebuilds the same infrastructure, and results are hard to replicate. This paper presents EREBOTS 4.0, an open-source, hybrid-AI, multi-agent framework that fills this gap for conversational assistants. Language-model agents plan and route requests, while deterministic tools compute exact results over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). An orchestrator selects one or more specialist agents per turn and calls them over the Agent2Agent protocol (A2A). A new agent, local or remote, is added by listing its URL in a configuration file. The framework also manages identity, user context with consent flags, task states and traces. Its A2A server passed 97 tracked requirements in the official A2A Technology Compatibility Kit, with no failures.

papers.title_en: Contextual Candour: Role-Aware Graduated Disclosure for LLMs over Mixed-Sensitivity Contexts
papers.authors: Devansh Srivastav, David Pape, Samira Abedini, Lea Schönherr
papers.evidence: 依据用户授权调整回答披露程度，减少敏感信息泄露。
papers.tldr: 大语言模型处理公开与机密信息混合的上下文时，二元式访问控制容易导致过度拒答或敏感信息泄露。论文提出按用户授权校准回答细节与敏感程度的“分级披露”，通过奖励优化引导适当抽象，并惩罚未经授权的事实泄露，包括改写和近似表达。在企业与临床基准上，该方法相比提示、门控及监督基线显著降低泄露，同时保持正确性与实用性。研究表明，披露控制应融入生成过程，而非仅决定是否回答。
papers.abstract_en: LLMs increasingly operate over mixed-sensitivity contexts, where they must reason over information ranging from public to confidential while disclosing only what the user is authorised to receive. Existing approaches enforce access control as a binary decision: either fully answering or refusing, without regulating how much or what kind of information is revealed if access is granted, leading to over-refusal or unintended leakage. We introduce graduated disclosure, an access-control formulation in which the level of detail and sensitivity in a model's response is calibrated to the user's authorisation rather than treated as a grant-or-deny decision. We model graduated disclosure as a disclosure-aware generation problem and propose a reward-based optimisation framework that shapes responses toward level-appropriate abstractions while penalising unauthorised factual leakage, including paraphrases and approximations. We evaluate our approach on enterprise and clinical benchmarks and compare it with prompt-based, gating, and supervised baselines. Experiments show that our method substantially reduces information leakage while preserving correctness and utility. These results suggest that disclosure control must be integrated into the generation process itself to enable secure yet useful LLM deployments.

papers.title_en: The Impact of Personalized AI Response Suggestions on Content Creators' Direct Messaging
papers.authors: Eun Jeong Kang, Jingruo Chen, Jadon Geathers, Susan Fussell
papers.evidence: 用户研究考察人工智能生成回复建议如何影响创作者与关注者的直接沟通。
papers.tldr: 内容创作者需应对大量粉丝私信，同时维持公众形象、管理受众期待，因而承受写作与情感劳动负担。研究先访谈15名创作者，再开发贴合个人写作风格的人工智能回复建议系统，并邀请13名创作者开展对比研究。参与者认可系统能缓和失礼表达、维护专业形象，并预期可提高回复率，但也需要额外核查生成内容是否符合自身真实意图。研究揭示，个性化回复辅助虽有助于效率，却可能将创作者的注意力从交流转向监督人工智能。
papers.abstract_en: Direct messaging is often employed by social media content creators to directly interact with followers. Those creators attempt to engage with followers in private communication, but they often encounter a large volume of messages. Through formative interviews with 15 creators, we found that creators frequently experience fatigue from writing suitable content, as they moderate audience expectations while concurrently integrating their media personas into responses. To explore how AI can address these challenges, we designed a system providing personalized, AI-generated response suggestions tailored to creators' writing styles to maintain their media personas. In a comparison study with 13 creators that examines how the system affects response behaviors, creators valued the system's ability to soften potential impoliteness and anticipated higher response rates, helping them maintain a professional image. However, creators reported additional labor in verifying the authenticity of AI outputs to mitigate risks caused by AI misalignment. Our results indicate that while AI suggestions enhance efficiency, they can undermine a creator's engagement in communication by shifting their attention toward monitoring AI.

papers.title_en: CogArena: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents on Interactive Behavioral Experiments
papers.authors: Kianté Fernandez, Caitlin Chen, Jialu Zhou, Bartek Sadowski, Anthony C. Miceli, Ian Krajbich
papers.evidence: 评测多模态智能体能否通过类似真人参与者的界面完成社会科学实验。
papers.tldr: 现有模型认知评估常将行为实验改写为文本，忽略人类参与者面对的视觉界面与时间压力，也难以判断智能体污染在线行为数据的风险。CogArena汇集十种行为实验，让智能体通过标准浏览器操作相同刺激与界面，分层评估完成情况、表现准确性和人类行为特征。四个多模态模型各任务运行十次，许多会话未完成，完成者也仅能稳定复现部分行为特征。该基准开放任务、评分代码和排行榜，区分任务完成与行为拟真。
papers.abstract_en: Claims about the cognitive capabilities of large language models are typically tested by translating behavioral paradigms into text prompts, bypassing the visual interfaces and time pressure through which human participants actually engage with experiments. At the same time, AI agents can now complete online behavioral tasks and produce human-like data, which raises concerns that online datasets in the social and behavioral sciences are increasingly open to contamination. We introduce CogArena, a benchmark of ten experimental paradigms from the social and behavioral sciences. Agents complete the experiments through a standard web browser, working with the same visual stimuli and response interfaces that online participants use. A three-level scoring procedure evaluates whether the agent completed the task, how accurately it performed, and whether its data show the behavioral signatures each paradigm reliably produces in people. Across four multimodal models, each run ten times per task, we find that finishing an experiment and reproducing its signatures are different things. Many sessions did not finish, and those that did reproduced some signatures reliably and others not at all. CogArena provides the tasks, scoring code, and a public leaderboard for new submissions.

papers.title_en: A Serious-Game Testbed for Self-Governing Human-Machine Institutions
papers.authors: Callum Berger, Jeremy Pitt, Stefan Sarkadi
papers.evidence: 严肃游戏测试人类与人工智能共同协调和治理混合群体
papers.tldr: 人机混合群体能否自主治理，不能只靠单个智能体的任务能力判断，还需观察群体如何制定和执行制度。论文提出严肃游戏与多智能体模拟器Megabike，将公共资源管理、合作求生和政体选择置于同一环境，允许人类或机器担任骑手。四十场语言模型实验显示，合作、懒惰、颠覆及对立倾向的不同组合，可能导致意外且适得其反的治理结果。平台以规则强制执行和全程行动日志，为后续系统研究人机混合机构提供可测量的实验载体。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents no longer act alone: they cooperate, coordinate and compete within and between groups, increasingly alongside humans who are in, on or out of ``the loop''. Whether such mixed groups can govern themselves is an open question about machine behaviour and human-computer interaction that needs a testbed for hybrid institutions. We present Megabike, a multi-agent simulator and serious game with interdependent arenas for common-pool resource management, cooperative survival and constitutional choice. Riders sharing a megabike must agree their arrangements for steering, pedalling and distributing resources, and their political regime, while negotiating with rival bikes and avoiding an existential threat. Every rule is enforced by the simulator, every action is logged, and any seat can be taken by a human or a machine, so governance can be studied under well-defined metrics. We demonstrate Megabike with forty sessions in which language-model riders with cooperative, lazy, subversive or opposing dispositions chose regimes, elected leaders and expelled one another. The results show that different combinations of agent archetypes could produce unexpected and counterproductive outcomes. We conclude with extensions for systematic experiments mixing human and computational agents.

papers.title_en: Peers4U: Designing Learner-Centered Virtual Peers for Children's Multimodal Mathematics Learning
papers.authors: Zhi Zheng, Binglin Liu, Weihao Chen, Lan Luo, Yu Mei, Jie Cai, Chun Yu, Yuanchun Shi
papers.evidence: 由大型语言模型驱动的虚拟同伴提供个性化多模态互动
papers.tldr: 儿童早期数学学习依赖操作、绘画和语言等具体表征，但如何通过虚拟同伴促进策略交流仍需探索。Peers4U根据学习者认知水平配置大模型驱动的虚拟同伴，为其分配过程可检查的多模态解法，并按教学进程组织讨论。涉及22名儿童和两名专家的研究显示，以学习者为中心的话题编排显著优于以角色人设为中心的基线；更多引领型同伴也促使儿童产出更多解法。研究为面向儿童的多模态虚拟同伴学习系统提供了设计启示。
papers.abstract_en: In early mathematics, children learn abstract concepts through concrete representations, such as manipulating objects, drawing, and speaking. Learning with peers can enrich this process by exposing children to diverse strategies and enabling them to exchange ideas through interaction. We realized this potential with virtual peers in Peers4U, a multimodal learning system to enhance children's mathematical conceptual understanding. Virtual peers driven by LLMs are personalized to the learner's cognitive level and assigned multimodal solutions with inspectable processes. During learning, peers engage in mixed-initiative interactions by responding, initiating topics, and advancing discussions along a pedagogical progression. A user study with 22 children and two experts showed our learner-centered topic orchestration significantly outperformed a persona-centered baseline, and children spontaneously authored new artifacts to demonstrate inspired ideas or share their own strategies, producing significantly more solutions when grouped with more Leading Peers. We contribute design insights for multimodal, learner-centered virtual peer systems.

papers.title_en: Penny for Your Prompts: A Measurement Study of Contextual Leakage in AI Chat Platforms
papers.authors: Paschalis Bekos, Billy Tsouvalas, Nick Nikiforakis, Michalis Polychronakis
papers.evidence: 审计人工智能聊天平台中私密对话的隐私泄漏
papers.tldr: 聊天平台承载大量私密对话，但网页嵌入的第三方分析、广告与会话回放脚本可能形成泄露通道。研究审计了42个通用及健康、法律、教育领域平台，结合网络拦截与浏览器脚本引擎级插桩，追踪数据流对应的用户操作和页面内容提取机制。结果发现，21个平台向第三方追踪器泄露对话标题，9个泄露用户提示词原文，部分平台还发送用户邮箱。研究揭示，对话内容可能与身份关联，聊天隐私保护不能忽视网页追踪生态。
papers.abstract_en: AI chatbot platforms have become one of the most popular web interfaces users interact with online, routinely receiving personal and intimate information shared under an expectation of privacy. Yet, on the web application side, these platforms have the ability to embed third-party analytics, advertising, and session replay scripts that operate silently alongside the chatbot, creating an underexamined channel for conversational data leakage towards third parties. We conduct the first systematic large-scale measurement study of contextual leakage in AI chatbots, auditing the web interfaces of 42 general-purpose and domain-specific (health, legal, and education) platforms. Beyond standard network interception, we instrument the browser at the JavaScript engine level to attribute each data flow to the exact user action that triggered it, and the DOM capture mechanism used to retrieve its content, a granularity invisible to network-layer analysis alone. We find that 21 of these platforms leak conversation titles to third-party trackers, while nine leak verbatim user prompts. Beyond content, we observe a substantial amount of chatbot platforms sending user emails to third-party trackers, enabling the association of conversational context with a user's identity. Our findings cast traditional web privacy issues under a new light, highlighting the privacy issues that are inherent in how users interact with modern AI chatbots.

papers.title_en: From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Ziyang Chen, Qian Li, Chengwei Qin
papers.evidence: 图形界面智能体执行跨应用长流程任务并学习可复用操作
papers.tldr: 长流程GUI任务中，动作记录难以说明哪些目标已完成，失败轨迹中的有效操作也常被丢弃。TAM以经验证的任务进展组织记忆：执行时更新剩余目标，任务结束后从成功或失败轨迹中抽取可复用操作。在MobileWorld上，仅进展状态就将成功率从12.0%提升至28.2%；完整方法较最强受测基线相对提升17.6%，每解决一项任务的全生命周期词元减少38.7%。其贡献是将已确认的局部成果同时用于当前执行与后续能力积累。
papers.abstract_en: GUI memory should preserve the results of past actions and learn reusable operations. This is difficult in long-horizon workflows, where agents must use information across applications and useful operations are interleaved with failed attempts. We introduce Task Advancement Memory (TAM), which defines task advancement as verified task progress, and supports ongoing task execution and learns reusable operations. During execution, Task Advancement State represents how verified task progress changes the remaining goals, allowing the agent to build on earlier achievements across applications. After each task, advancement supervision identifies and abstracts the interactions that produced a verified local result. The learned operations preserve the relation between required inputs, expected outcomes, and verification conditions. This retains locally successful operations from both successful and failed tasks. On MobileWorld GUI-only tasks, Advancement State alone raises success from 12.0% to 28.2%. Full TAM achieves a 17.6% relative gain in task success over the strongest evaluated baseline and reduces lifecycle tokens per solved task by 38.7%. On SPA-Bench, TAM achieves state-of-the-art task success in the single-app English Level 3 setting.

papers.title_en: BehaviorMem: Building and Evaluating User Memory from Real-World E-Commerce Behavior Streams
papers.authors: Sizhe Wang, Xinghao Fang, Rui Qiu, Zhenjia Ma, Dagui Chen, Kun Kuang, Hongcheng Guo
papers.evidence: 从明确表达与隐式行为交互构建并评测长期用户记忆
papers.tldr: 电商用户的浏览、收藏和购买隐含着偏好与需求，但现有记忆方法多面向语言交互，难以区分记住行为证据与推断潜在偏好的能力。论文提出BehaviorMem，以事实与推断、长期与短期两个维度组织记忆，并构建覆盖1194名用户、17462批行为及三年多历史的评测基准。跨两种记忆构建器和两种任务读取器的实验中，该方法在两类能力上均领先参评智能体记忆方法。研究为持续行为记忆提供了统一评测框架，也揭示两类能力需要分别衡量。
papers.abstract_en: User memory helps personalized systems build on their understanding of users over time. In e-commerce, users convey their preferences and needs through both explicit language and implicit interactions with products. We study memory built from logs of these interactions, examining how it can \emph{remember} concrete evidence and established interests, and use that evidence to \emph{infer} underlying needs and preferences that inform judgments beyond well-observed product domains. Existing memory methods primarily target language-based interactions, and evaluations offer limited real behavioral data and limited separation of these capabilities. This leaves open how to jointly support and separately evaluate remembering and inference from behavioral logs. We formulate the problem of continual behavioral user memory around these joint requirements and develop a dedicated evaluation framework and memory method to address them. \textbf{BehaviorMemBench} is a benchmark built from real e-commerce logs covering 1{,}194 users and 17{,}462 behavioral batches over more than three years, with automatic future-behavior labels and a task-independent memory interface to separately evaluate remembering and inference under a common protocol. \textbf{BehaviorMem} is a memory design that organizes explicit behavioral facts and inferred user characteristics across long-term and short-term scopes in a two-axis state, with evidence-grounded formation, continual maintenance, and query-independent readout. Experiments across two builders and two task readers show that BehaviorMem leads the evaluated agentic memories on remember and infer, and reveal different method rankings across the two capabilities and competitive statistical baselines. Validation on a public dataset further supports its usefulness for downstream tasks based on behavioral histories.

papers.title_en: Reflective Computing
papers.authors: Md Haseen Akhtar
papers.evidence: 提出以反思为目标的人机交互设计范式
papers.tldr: 交互技术与生成式人工智能追求即时响应，却可能挤压人们停顿、理解与自主判断的空间。论文分析1996—2026年134个交互系统，从设计缺口归纳出反思计算的七个维度，并由独立编码员评分。仅20个系统符合定义，没有系统在全部维度上表现突出；允许用户掌控节奏与更高评分显著相关。研究将支持人的反思能力确立为设计目标，强调慢下来只有出于自主选择才有价值。
papers.abstract_en: Interactive technology is increasingly built for speed, and generative AI now answers before a question is fully formed. Yet the capacity to pause, interpret and decide for oneself is central to wellbeing, learning and meaningful use. HCI has named paradigms for sensing emotion, changing behavior, calming attention and tracking the self. However, none of them takes human reflection, and the slowing down it requires, as its organizing aim. This article defines that paradigm, reflective computing, and derives it from what thirty years of designs lack. We analyzed 134 interactive systems from 17 ACM venues (1996-2026) in two phases. First, an abductive gap analysis read every system against reflection theory, and seven recurring gaps defined seven dimensions, namely tempo agency, invitational form, interpretive openness, reflective depth, temporal span, protected idleness and ethical non-extraction. Second, two independent coders scored every system with a codebook (Krippendorff's alpha 0.67 to 0.84 for five dimensions; ICC 0.82 for the overall score). The system sets the pace in 51 designs, 74 support only momentary use, only 12 scaffold reflection beyond description, and 56 papers are silent on the inner states they collect. No system expresses all seven dimensions strongly, and only 20 meet the definition. Slow and experience centered design comes closest, whereas persuasive technology and human-AI interaction score lowest. Factor and latent class analyses reveal two cultures of reflection, one working through form and the other through scaffolded thought, which only one system combines. Systems that let people set the pace score markedly higher, even with paradigm and form controlled (odds ratio 13.5). Hence, reflective computing is proposed as a paradigm whose aim is a human capacity rather than a system function, and which treats slowness as valuable only when people choose it.

papers.title_en: Causal DAG-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Physical Activity Maintenance: Using Prior Data to Inform Future Deployment
papers.authors: Xueqing Liu, Young Hyun Cho, Bhanu Teja Gullapalli, Predrag Klasnja, Susan Murphy
papers.evidence: 通过在线强化学习个性化数字身体活动干预
papers.tldr: 数字健康干预可个性化促进身体活动，但长期维持面临个体数据稀疏、状态与奖励部分可观测、反馈延迟及干预负担等难题。论文以专家指定的因果有向无环图指导在线强化学习，统一设计状态、隐状态估计、延迟贡献归因及正负干预路径。研究利用既往微随机试验数据校准纵向模拟器，在部署前比较候选方案，服务于即将开展的ADAPT试验每日两次活动建议个性化。其贡献是整合因果知识与历史数据支持长期决策，摘要未报告实际部署效果。
papers.abstract_en: Digital health interventions can provide scalable, personalized support for physical activity (PA), yet sustaining PA over the long-term remains difficult. Because affective experiences with PA are important for activity sustainment, we developed an online reinforcement learning (RL) system for the forthcoming ADAPT factorial trial that personalizes twice-daily activity suggestions aimed at improving affective associations with PA. This setting poses several challenges: participant-specific data are scarce relative to the candidate state space, important states and rewards are partially observed, interventions are frequent while the primary outcome is measured weekly, and activity suggestions can both improve PA-related experiences and increase intervention burden. We address these challenges using an expert-specified causal directed acyclic graph as an integrated RL design tool, guiding state construction, estimation of partially observed states, delayed credit assignment, and representation of beneficial and adverse intervention pathways. We further construct a longitudinal simulator calibrated from a prior micro-randomized trial to compare candidate RL designs under realistic state evolution, missingness, and participant heterogeneity before deployment. Together, this work illustrates how causal domain knowledge and prior trial data can make long-horizon, participant-specific RL more practical for digital health interventions targeting sustained behavior change.

papers.title_en: MAREval: A Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Natural Language Recommendation Explanations
papers.authors: Reza Yousefi Maragheh, Jayesh Uddhav Kudase, Aysenur Inan, Ramin Giahi, Kai Zhao, Parth Parikh, Jianpeng Xu, Jason Cho, Evren Korpeoglu, Sushant Kumar
papers.evidence: 评估推荐解释以提升用户信任、透明度与参与度
papers.tldr: 推荐解释的人工评估成本高、难以规模化，单智能体大模型评估又易受提示影响且输出不稳定。MAREval以辩论链组织规划、主持与仲裁智能体，结合多轮评估和蒙特卡洛采样，提高判断一致性与稳健性。作者报告，该框架在公开及私有电商数据上比强基线更贴近人工判断，重复试验波动更低，并通过生产质量门槛；线上实验的参与度和收入指标也显著提升。该研究为推荐解释提供了可扩展、面向实际业务的自动评估方案。
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating natural language explanations in recommender systems is essential for fostering user trust, transparency, and engagement. However, existing evaluation approaches like human evaluations, while accurate, are resource-intensive and impractical at the scale required by modern recommendation platforms. Also, automated methods using single-agent LLMs suffer from prompt sensitivity and inconsistent outputs. To address these challenges, we propose MAREval, a structured multi-agent framework for evaluating recommendation explanations using large language models. MAREval orchestrates (i) a planner agent that uses a novel Chain of Debate (CoD) prompting strategy to coordinate agent roles and enforce logically consistent evaluation plans; (ii) a moderator agent that regulates discussions by mitigating prompt drift; and (iii) an arbitrator agent that aggregates outputs from multiple evaluation rounds and (iv) a Monte Carlo sampling method, improving robustness and alignment with human judgment. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on both public (TopicalChat) and proprietary recommendation datasets, demonstrating that MAREval outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Comprehensive experiments on a public benchmark and a proprietary e-commerce dataset show that MAREval improves alignment with human judgments over strong singleand multi-agent baselines. Stability analyses indicate substantially lower variability across repeated trials. In a large human-annotation gate, MAREval meets production quality thresholds where prior evaluators fall short, and online A/B testing demonstrates statistically significant improvements in engagement and revenue metrics. These results establish MAREval as a scalable and reliable solution for human-aligned evaluation of recommendation explanations in real-world systems

papers.title_en: Measuring Users' Security and Privacy Concerns About Third-Party Community Bots on Discord
papers.authors: Kofi Ampomah, Tu Le
papers.evidence: 研究线上社区机器人治理及其引发的用户隐私担忧
papers.tldr: Discord社区机器人由管理员安装，却可能访问未参与决策的成员数据，相关安全与隐私风险缺乏透明说明。研究分析23102个机器人及183142条评论，通过大模型知识蒸馏、分类器与人工验证，识别8832条相关评论并归纳31类主题。数据共享和收集最受关注，忏悔与匿名类机器人的相关评论检出率超过50%，星级及权限指标难以充分反映这些讨论。作者构建BotLens审计原型，融合评论与元数据，辅助社区评估机器人。
papers.abstract_en: Third-party community-based bots are central to how social platforms such as Discord work. They moderate content, manage roles, play music, and support AI-assisted conversations across millions of servers. Yet when a bot is installed in a server, it can access messages, user profiles, and server metadata concerning members who did not participate in the installation decision, with no standardized way to communicate the associated security and privacy implications. In this paper, we analyze 23,102 third-party Discord bots and 183,142 user reviews spanning 49 detected languages and five years of feedback (2021-2026). We employ LLM-based knowledge distillation and fine-tune a DeBERTa-based classifier to identify candidate security and privacy (S&P)-relevant reviews. After manually validating the complete classifier-positive set, we retain 8,832 reviews identified as S&P-relevant, representing an observed pipeline yield of 4.82%, and map them to a 31-theme S&P taxonomy extending prior work. Our results show that S&P-related reviews focus heavily on Data Sharing (30.5%) and Data Collection (16.2%). Confession and anonymity bots have pipeline-identified SPRRs above 50%, more than ten times the ecosystem-wide pipeline yield of 4.82%. Star ratings may obscure the frequency and valence of S&P-related discussion, while conventional metadata features, such as permission count and administrator status, show only weak associations with user-reported S&P concerns. We then build BotLens, a proof-of-concept auditing framework that combines review-derived S&P signals with bot metadata to provide on-demand decision support for the community-based bot ecosystem. BotLens exposes six tools through a Model Context Protocol server, supporting bot-level checkups, server-wide comparison, and integration with AI agents.

papers.title_en: Words or Deeds? How LLMs Predict Users' Decisions in Human-Agent Dialogue
papers.authors: Baiqiao Zhang, Shuai Ma, Zhifeng Liao, Chao Zhou, Jianshu Wang, Yuhan Zhao, Chaoyue Zhang, Tongjun Si, Yuying Tang, Xiangxian Li, Yong-Jin Liu, Yulong Bian
papers.evidence: 研究语言模型智能体如何在重复人机对话中解读人的言语与行为
papers.tldr: 利益部分冲突时，用户可能先承诺合作再违约，依赖对话预测决策的智能体因此面临误判风险。研究让42名用户与五种大五人格智能体博弈，基于1260轮记录评估八个开放权重模型。仅用行为记录的预测AUC达0.80，加入对话未见显著增益，违约轮次准确率却从65%降至17%。模型过度相信口头表态，也未充分捕捉交互对象及人格匹配的影响，提示决策预测应结合行为历史与交互情境校准承诺可信度。
papers.abstract_en: Web systems increasingly predict users' decisions from what users say, yet when interests partly conflict, users may promise to cooperate to win the other side's cooperation and then not do so. Sales or service agents that rely on such promises may grant concessions to users who then do not keep their promises, at a cost to the party they represent. We test how LLMs combine users' statements with decision records to predict users' decisions, using 1,260 rounds in which 42 users played a repeated prisoner's dilemma-style game with five agents, each prompted to express a dominant Big Five trait, and could talk with the agent before every decision. Across eight open-weight LLMs, predictions from decision records separated cooperation from defection well (AUC = .80), and adding dialogue brought no detectable gain. With dialogue, predictions agreed with users' statements more often, and errors concentrated on rounds in which users broke their statements: accuracy on rounds with a statement barely changed (.73 to .74), while it rose on kept statements (.76 to .95) and fell sharply on broken ones (.65 to .17). Predictions weighted statements more heavily than users' behavior warranted: when users stated a decision they had not yet made in that game, the predicted probability of keeping it rose from .13 to .69, whereas users kept .40 of such statements. Users' decisions also varied with the agent they faced, but predictions hardly reflected this: users cooperated more with the Agreeableness agent than with the Extraversion agent (70.6% vs. 54.5%), whereas predicted cooperation was nearly identical (64.5% vs. 63.1%). Users also cooperated more with an agent when they themselves scored higher on that agent's trait, whereas predicted cooperation barely changed with these scores. Dialogue-based predictions should therefore weigh users' statements by their earlier decisions and the agent they face.

papers.title_en: PULSE: Personalized Opportunistic Learning for Wearable Devices
papers.authors: Mattia Giovanni Campana, Dariush Salami, Hüseyin Yiğitler, Stephan Sigg
papers.evidence: 在可穿戴设备间选择近邻节点开展机会式协作学习
papers.tldr: 可穿戴设备部署后面临个体数据分布变化，单机适应受限于数据不足，持续联网协作又难以保障。PULSE将每次设备相遇视为在线协作决策，允许跳过交互，并依据历史交互选择同伴，仅融合与本地学习方向兼容的梯度。在活动识别、跌倒检测和压力识别中，其保持或提升个性化分类性能，较机会式模型平均减少80%—94%的同伴辅助交换。硬件实验显示实现占用149.8 KiB内存，说明选择性协作可兼顾个性化效果与资源约束。
papers.abstract_en: Wearable devices increasingly support personalized health and well-being applications, but post-deployment data can differ substantially from those used for training, while purely local adaptation may be limited by the data available on a single device during real-world operation. Conventional federated and decentralized learning rely on recurrent communication and stable connectivity, whereas existing opportunistic approaches often exploit available encounters without adequately considering their utility, compatibility, or communication cost.   We propose PULSE, an event-driven framework for personalized opportunistic learning that treats each encounter as an online collaboration decision, selecting either no interaction or a promising nearby peer. Peer gradients are incorporated only when compatible with the local learning direction, while past interactions guide future peer selection. Across human activity recognition, fall detection, and stress recognition under synthetic and real contact traces, PULSE preserves or improves personalized classification performance, while reducing peer-assisted exchanges by 80-94% compared with opportunistic model averaging. On-device experiments further demonstrate its feasibility on wearable hardware: peer-assisted operations require limited energy, while the complete implementation occupies 149.8 KiB of RAM and 561.8 KiB of flash. The obtained results show that selective opportunistic collaboration can provide effective personalization while limiting communication and resource demands on constrained wearable devices.

papers.title_en: Same Answer, Different Reasons: Trace-Level Divergence in Multilingual Large Language Models
papers.authors: Rui Sun, Peizhao Mei, Xiewei Cheng, Kaizhuo Chen, Taoran Li, Zhiyuan Yu, Varun Chandrasekaran
papers.evidence: 比较不同语言用户获得的可见推理依据是否一致。
papers.tldr: 多语言模型即使给出相同答案，也可能向不同语言用户提供不同的推理依据，整段回答相似度难以揭示这种差异。论文将可见推理轨迹视为结构化序列，分别衡量结构相似性、顺序一致性与整体相似性，并按语言对校准。在三个推理基准、七种语言和六个模型上，整体相似度最高四分位的样本中，52.1%—67.3%未进入结构相似度最高四分位。人工评判更支持结构指标，说明多语言解释一致性需要轨迹级评估。
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual large language models are increasingly deployed in settings where visible reasoning traces support verification, education, and safety auditing, yet standard evaluations typically measure only final-answer agreement or holistic response similarity. As a result, they establish outcome consistency without determining whether users across languages receive comparable supporting evidence. We introduce a trace-level divergence framework that compares visible reasoning traces as structured sequences, decomposing agreement into structural similarity, order consistency, and holistic similarity, with pair-specific calibration to enable comparison across languages. Across three reasoning benchmarks, seven languages, and six frontier LLMs, the natural baseline---embedding each whole response and comparing the two by cosine---systematically overstates agreement: $52.1\%$--$67.3\%$ of examples in the top quartile of holistic similarity are not in the top quartile of structural similarity. This dissociation is stable across sentence encoders and step segmentations, and blind bilingual annotation studies in two English-anchored language pairs show that human judgments align with structural similarity rather than with the holistic baseline. A same-language control shows that the level of divergence is language-specific: two English traces for paraphrases of the same question agree more closely than an English trace and its counterparts in other languages. Our results show that answer-level and holistic evaluations can substantially overestimate the consistency of multilingual explanatory artifacts, motivating trace-level evaluation for reliable multilingual deployment.

papers.title_en: Distill, Debate, Discover: Grounding Multi-Agent Research Ideation in Graph-Distilled Insights
papers.authors: Qianran Ma, Muxin Liu, Grace Kim, Xiao Liang, Chris Callison-Burch
papers.evidence: 通过多智能体协作生成研究构想，并以文献为智能体提供专长
papers.tldr: 多智能体辩论可辅助科研构思，但如何让各智能体具备有差异且有依据的专业知识仍是难题。InsightAgents从相关论文图谱中蒸馏研究路线演变、底层假设与未解挑战，据此构建专家智能体，通过辩论共同确定问题并完善研究方案。在100个自然语言处理研究主题上，与三种框架进行比较，两个大模型评审均给出五个维度平均得分最高的评价，且在线、离线知识设置下均成立。其贡献是以文献洞见而非单纯角色设定支撑多智能体科研协作。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support research idea generation and scientific discovery. Multi-agent debate offers a collaborative approach to this task by bringing together diverse perspectives to develop research ideas. However, a key challenge is how to equip agents with distinct and meaningful expertise to guide their contributions. Inspired by how researchers draw on accumulated research experience during collaboration, we introduce InsightAgents, a framework that constructs literature-grounded agent expertise by distilling insights from graphs of related papers. Guided by insights that trace evolving research approaches, reveal underlying assumptions, and identify unresolved challenges, within a line of research, agents jointly identify a research problem and propose, challenge, and refine potential approaches through debate to develop a research proposal. We evaluate InsightAgents against three research idea generation frameworks on 100 NLP research topics through pairwise comparisons by two LLM judges. In both online and offline knowledge settings, InsightAgents achieves the highest average score across the five evaluation dimensions under both judges.

papers.title_en: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
papers.authors: Yihao Hu, Zhihao Wen, Yitong Lin, Siyuan Lu, Pan Wang, Wei Wu, Jiang-Ming Yang, Tao Lin
papers.evidence: 为工具使用型AI智能体合成有依据的交互轨迹
papers.tldr: 工具调用轨迹即使成功，也可能缺少多步依赖，或包含无法由智能体当时可见信息支持的动作。Trajectory2Gym围绕覆盖不足的组合结构构造可执行交互，仅从实际执行中提取有信息依据的决策，并按原始交互归一化训练权重。在五种规模的Qwen3上，三个基准均获提升，等权平均分提高16.9—29.8个百分点。研究表明，训练数据的关键不仅是成功数量，更是依赖覆盖与决策可学习性。
papers.abstract_en: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time. We identify two coupled requirements for effective trajectory supervision: compositional coverage, so that important observation-action dependencies are represented, and decision grounding, so that each supervised action is supported by the learner-visible interaction history. We introduce Trajectory2Gym, which constructs executable interactions around under-supported compositional structures and derives supervision only from grounded decisions in their realized executions. Structural-support selection allocates the resulting experience, while parent-normalized supervised fine-tuning preserves the semantic interaction as the unit of training weight. This reframes trajectory generation as the deliberate construction of learnable interaction experience, rather than the collection of successful trajectories. Across five Qwen3 scales, Trajectory2Gym improves Tau1, Tau2, and BFCL at every tested scale, increasing the equal-weight three-benchmark mean by 16.9-29.8 percentage points. The gains are strongest in stateful and multi-turn interaction, where later decisions depend on earlier observations and feedback. Our results suggest that scaling tool-use agents depends not only on collecting more successful trajectories, but on constructing interactions whose dependencies are represented and whose decisions are learnable from the agent's visible history.

papers.title_en: SearchHorizonBench: A Benchmark for Search Value in AI Agents
papers.authors: Jingjie Ning, Xueqi Li, Yibo Kong
papers.evidence: 评估智能体何时应继续搜索
papers.tldr: 智能体需要判断追加搜索是否值得付出成本，而答对概率并不等于搜索的边际收益。该基准通过同一历史下的配对续执行与重复运行，区分预期搜索增益和生成噪声，并评估决策效用。数据涵盖3168个问题、45632次执行；历史校准使布里尔误差降低16.2%，但受测估计器解释的增益方差不足2%。参考词元价格下，免费选择观测带来2.49点效用机会，表明预测搜索价值仍具挑战，并提供可复用评测基础。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents must decide when another search is worth its cost. Answer-success probabilities capture question difficulty, while this decision requires estimating the additional benefit of search. We introduce SearchHorizonBench, a benchmark for learning and evaluating search value from execution experience. Paired continuations and repeated executions separate expected search gain from generation noise and connect prediction quality to decision utility. The resource contains 45,632 executions across 3,168 questions. On 1,632 held-out questions, historical calibration reduces Brier error by 16.2%, with the improvement concentrated in success-level information. Search gains have a standard deviation of 21.4 percentage points, and tested historical estimators explain less than 2% of this variance in point estimates. Matched-configuration learning curves probe this distinction across training scales. At the reference token price, free selection observations yield a 2.49-point utility opportunity over the best constant action, driven primarily by gain information. Reusable histories, frozen splits, strong baselines and scoring tools provide a common foundation for developing and evaluating value-aware search agents.

papers.title_en: Collective Emergent Alignment: Measuring and Amplifying Interaction-Induced Reasoning Alignment in Multi-Agent LLMs
papers.authors: Boxuan Wang, Zhuoyun Li, Sarvapali D. Ramchurn, Xiaowei Huang, Yi Dong
papers.evidence: 评估多个大语言模型智能体交互产生的推理对齐增益
papers.tldr: 多智能体交互能否带来超越个体自我改进的推理对齐，仍缺乏系统测量。论文提出REMAP，以语义覆盖率和交互特有增益，衡量推理与参考内容的一致性，并设计紧凑的事实级通信。在多个模型家族和两个多跳推理基准上，交互普遍带来正向增益，尤其有利于整合分散证据；事实交换还提升任务表现并降低通信开销。研究将集体涌现对齐与信息传递联系起来，揭示信息获取、本地内容保留及通信效率之间的权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can exhibit emergent behaviors through interaction, yet whether a similar phenomenon exists for reasoning alignment remains largely unexplored. We study whether agent interaction produces additional reference-grounded reasoning alignment beyond matched individual self-refinement, and introduce REMAP (Reference-Entailment-Matrix for Agentic Process), a framework that quantifies this effect through Semantic Coverage and interaction-specific alignment gains. Across diverse model families and two multi-hop reasoning benchmarks, we observe broadly positive interaction gains, particularly on reasoning content that depends on integrating evidence distributed across agents. These gains are consistently associated with independently measured peer-information recovery, while further analysis reveals composition-dependent heterogeneity effects and asymmetric information transfer across agent capability levels. Motivated by these findings, we further introduce a fact-level multi-agent communication framework that replaces full reasoning-trace exchange with compact, gap-aware, and selectively routed information. Our experiments show that compact fact exchange improves reasoning alignment and task performance while reducing communication overhead, whereas more selective communication exposes a trade-off between acquiring distributed information, retaining local content, and communication efficiency. Overall, our results show that collective emergent alignment can be quantified, linked to information-transfer patterns, and used to guide more effective multi-agent communication.

papers.title_en: ClinVerse: A Realistic Multi-Agent Diagnostic Environment for Training and Evaluating Medical Agents
papers.authors: Sirry Chen, Fangke Chen, Xuanwen Ding, Wei Chen, Zhongyu Wei
papers.evidence: 通过交互式多智能体环境训练和评估临床决策
papers.tldr: 现有医疗智能体多依赖静态问答训练与评估，难以学习主动问诊、检查决策和动态交互。ClinVerse基于真实电子病历构建的15万例ClinPatient诊断病例，组织六类临床角色协作，让医生智能体从主诉出发逐步收集证据并诊断。规则评分覆盖信息获取、检查开具和诊断准确性，兼作训练奖励与评估指标。实验显示，三类共九种自进化方法均能提升环境内诊断能力，为交互式医疗智能体提供可扩展的训练评估平台。
papers.abstract_en: Disease diagnosis is a key application of large language model (LLM) agents in healthcare. However, existing medical agents are primarily trained and evaluated with static question-answering data, providing limited opportunities to learn active information acquisition, examination decision-making, and dynamic clinical interaction. To address this limitation, we present ClinVerse, an interactive, real-data-grounded multi-agent environment designed for training and evaluating medical diagnostic agents. Built on ClinPatient, a scalable dataset comprising 150k diagnostic cases derived from real-world electronic health records, ClinVerse supports coordinated interactions among six specialized clinical roles. Specifically, a doctor agent starts from an initial patient complaint, progressively gathers clinical evidence through patient interviews and examination requests, and ultimately produces a diagnosis. For each interaction trajectory, a rule-based scoring framework quantifies information acquisition, examination ordering, and diagnostic accuracy. These trajectory-level scores serve as reward signals for agent training while also enabling scalable evaluation. In experiments, we evaluate various general-purpose and medical-domain models and show that nine self-evolution methods across three categories consistently improve agents' diagnostic capabilities within ClinVerse. We further analyze the interplay among model capability, environment feedback, and self-evolution methods.
